defect: divided_clk has no timing clock definition
rationale: divided_clk is a sequential clock signal derived from ref_clk and clocks status; without a clock definition, timing analysis has no period or relationship for status.

mutation.description: Omitted the generated-clock definition for divided_clk from constraints.sdc.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Retained the counter-based divided-clock structure and a downstream clocked register; removed the configurable handshake and technology cells.

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: divided_clk is a counter bit clocking status but has no generated clock, so that flop is unclocked.
